programme.desc: When known rapper Poetic Rhymes goes to jail, he encounters an unusual cellmate that alters his views on reality. When he is released from prison, his new visions and knowledge begins to affect those he loves the most.

programme.title: The House on Adams Drive (2024)
programme.desc: Sean is convinced the only way to keep the woman of his dreams happy is by obtaining as much money as possible. programme.title: Induced (2022)
programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.title: Halloween Kickback (2021)
programme.desc: Three friends who went through college together find themselves in a financial bind after graduating college. They throw a Halloween party to raise money to get their lives on track.

programme.title: Induced 2 (2024)
programme.desc: After a harrowing event that nearly kills Claudia, she and her husband try their best to move on. Claudia and Marcus then hire a new mid-wife to assist as they prepare for their new child. But they don’t know that Erica is lurking in the shadows, and she wants that baby.

programme.title: Grave Secrets (2026)
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments (2026)
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole (2025)
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Cougar (2025)
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva (2025)
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Money Gang Lit (2025)
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Who is She (2025)
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Something Old (2024)
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Scandalous (2025)
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: CODE (2025)
programme.desc: Dallas artist MALIK SCHAEFER, also known as CODE, is a rising star in the underground rap scene. Although his checkered past has led him down the wrong road at times, with the help of his best friend, STYLES, Malik is back on the fast-track to success. That is, until he reconnects with the dangerous love of his life, SOPHIA ORTEGA, who threatens to destroy it all. Malik must decide to either follow his heart or live by the code that has served him well for many years: family over everything.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Lo que al principio parece violencia de pandillas se convierte en un ataque terrorista coordinado. Varios lugares de Mumbai — CST, Café Leopold, Hotel Taj, Oberoi y Chabad House — son atacados al mismo tiempo. Parvati aprovecha el caos para demostrar su valentía periodística.

programme.title: Lockhart: Liberando el Talisman (2024)
programme.desc: La vida normal de un hombre da un vuelco cuando hereda un antiguo artefacto de cristal y se convierte en "la clave" para liberar al mundo del dominio de la esclavitud energética y del Gobierno Mundial Único clandestino. Después de un intenso y peligroso trabajo de detective, Jon Lockhart descubre que la familia Lockhart ha estado ocultando el cristal, también conocido como "El Corazón", de los malvados Illuminati durante los últimos 1.000 años, desde la época de Robert the Bruce y las Cruzadas. El Corazón de Cristal contiene un código científico que puede generar suficiente energía limpia e ilimitada para alimentar al mundo entero. Ahora Jon debe encontrar una manera de proteger el secreto de su familia y el futuro suministro de energía manteniendo el Corazón de Cristal a salvo de la élite "Illuminati", que no se detendrá ante nada para encontrar el corazón y finalmente controlar el suministro de energía del mundo para siempre.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo (2024)
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters of the Night (2026)

La película presenta las diferentes estrategias mortales que los leones, leopardos y hienas utilizan para cazar por la noche. programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Orange Free State of South Africa: White Blesbuck, Tsessebe & More"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.sub-title: "3 Bucks In 4 Years… And We Just Made This Stand Even Better"
programme.desc: On just 40 acres in Missouri, Mike has built one of the most consistent stand setups we’ve ever seen. He’s killed 3 mature bucks in 4 years from this ONE stand… and it’s not by accident. In this video, we break down exactly why this stand is so deadly—from access and wind to natural movement and terrain—and then take it a step further. We’re improving the setup with bedding thickets and hinge cutting to make it even harder for bucks to avoid. If you’re hunting a smaller property, this is a blueprint you can apply right now.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.sub-title: "Tarif's Texas Double: When Big Bucks Meet Their Match"

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Clampett is told by a representative of an oil company that the swamp behind his shack is full of oil. (The oil company employee has been hauled in by Jed's daughter Elly May who asks whether she can keep him.) Later, Mr. Brewster, the head of the oil company, does a deal with Jed. Jed tells Cousin Pearl that he'll receive 25 to 100 of "some new kind of dollar." Pearl, thinking Jed has been "slickered", asks what kind of dollar he's talking about. "Million dollars," Granny, Jed's mother-in-law, replies. "Jed, you're a millionaire," Pearl says. "Yeah, that's what that Brewster fella said." Pearl convinces Jed to move to Beverly Hills, California (she pronounces it "Cal-i-forn-ee") and volunteers her son, Jethro, to drive Jed, Elly May and Granny there. Upon arriving, Granny complains the hills aren't that high. Jed says at least there are hills and "we'll be among our own kind of people." The Clampett clan mistakes their new home for a prison and the groundskeepers for prisoners. The Clampetts end up in jail, but Milburn Drysdale, their new banker, gets them freed. But, as Drysdale tries to take the Clampetts to their new mansion, the foursome flee, fearing they're going to prison.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts begin to settle in their new home in Beverly Hills, California. They are having to adjust to things such as refrigerators (Granny remarks how a ham will require two days to thaw out), ovens and the "cement pond." Jed also is having to confront how his daughter Elly May is maturing. He tells her that he, in effect, raised her as a boy and should not have. Jethro also encounters a flamingo that he thinks is a chicken (which causes Jed to suspect Jethro has been sneaking drinks of moonshine). Meanwhile, Miss Hathaway, executive secretary to banker Milburn Drysdale, mistakes the Clampetts for "domestic" help. She thinks Granny is a cook and Elly a maid.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: While Granny boils pool water for washing (due to the "lack of a pump") and Elly May gets a feminine make-over by Miss Hathaway, cousin Pearl is back at the cabin making eyes with the visiting oil man while he gives her a ride to the nearest phone.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mr. Drysdale panics when Mrs. Drysdale comes back from Boston early, because she'll meet the Clampetts. He sets Miss Hathaway on a plan to get them to go to Palm Springs. Meanwhile, Grannie and Jed come to think Mrs. Drysdale is a drunk and make plans to cure her.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Grannie prepares her special mash to help cure Mrs. Drysdale of her drinking problem while Jed does as Mr. Drysdale suggests and buys stock: cows, goats, pigs, and chickens! Meanwhile, Mrs. Drysdale recovers from the shock of her first meeting with the Clampetts and is convinced she's imagining things.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny wants to go home because folks is so unfriendly no one has come to call. Jed convinces her they should call on them, and they find that people welcome them and give them all manner of gifts when they show up on Halloween in their normal hillbilly clothes. Also, Jed works on getting Pearl to come visit while she's trying to get hitched to the oilman and find a young man for Jethrine.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Ellie May starts wearing dresses but takes it as an insult when someone says she looks like a city girl. Miss Hathaway takes Jethro bowling and begins to show an interest in him.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed enrolls Jethro at an exclusive Beverly Hills elementary school. Millicent Schuyler-Potts, the proprietor of the school, is aghast when Jed and Jethro show up, convinced this is part of some ghastly hoax. After Jed says that banker Milburn Drysdale is his neighbor, she calls the banker. It turns out that Drysdale's bank holds the mortgage on the school. Schulyer-Potts suddenly warms to the charms of the Clampetts, even if it means accepting Jethro as a fifth grader.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: En este episodio especial, un grupo de espectadores selectos se enfrentará a algunos de los más memorables invitados de Jerry.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Edgar Vallejo, desaparecido en diciembre de 2022, dejó una carta de advertencia a su hija, revelando que saldría con su hermano José Miguel. Tras investigaciones, se descubrió su trágico paradero, el motivo, sus bienes inmuebles y su dinero.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ante la creciente delincuencia y la ineficacia policial, los ciudadanos recurren a la seguridad privada, la unión y vigilancia organizada surgen como respuesta urgente, evidenciando vacíos en la justicia y protección policial.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, los feminicidios aumentan alarmantemente. Leidy Johana Hernández, víctima de su pareja Nelson Arturo, sufrió años de abuso. A pesar de las advertencias de sus padres, Leidy no escapó. Su cuerpo fue hallado en su casa. La historia revela la urgencia de intervención y denuncia para prevenir tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Accidentes eléctricos en Colombia han dejado víctimas con secuelas graves. Jóvenes como Carol y Samir luchan por justicia contra empresas de energía, mientras la falta de medidas de seguridad pone en evidencia graves fallos en la infraestructura.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Funza, Cundinamarca, más de 2000 personas fueron engañadas por una asociación que prometía viviendas. Desde estafas hasta terrenos inapropiados, el sueño de tener casa propia se convirtió en una amarga pesadilla de promesas rotas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carlos Ariel Torres, líder de una secta, estafó a sus seguidores con promesas de salvación apocalíptica y manipulación, llevándolos a vender bienes para comprar tierras en Ecuador. Actualmente, enfrenta varias denuncias por fraude.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter & Nance interact with celebs on social media. James rides his bike to work. Gil & George say Oh, Hello to Toni & Candace.

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A bohemian couple goes to great lengths to make sure that their restaurant order is ethical and humane. Guest starring Steve Buscemi and Jason Sudeikis.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred and Carrie meet the Mayor of Portland who gives them a special assignment. Special Guest Star Kyle MacLachlan. Also guest starting Aubrey Plaza and Sam Adams.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred and Carrie discover that their maid is none other than their favorite singer-songwriter Aimee Mann. Guest Starring Aimee Mann and Sarah McLachlan.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: When the Mayor goes missing, Fred and Carrie begin a frantic search for him. Special Guest Star Kyle MacLachlan. Also guest starring Edie McClurg, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani and Sam Adams.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: All of Portlandia is swept up in the excitement of a new music and film festival. Guest starring Selma Blair, Jenny Conlee, Colin Meloy, James Mercer, Corin Tucker and Gus Van Sant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor turns to Fred and Carrie to help him put together a big league baseball team. Special Guest Star Kyle MacLachlan. Also guest starring Heather Graham and Nick Kroll.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred and Carrie learn about the art of mixology and love as they venture outside of Portland on a quest. Guest stars Andy Samberg, Kumail Nanjiani.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Doug & Claire watch a box set of Battlestar Galactica which becomes an obsession that takes over their lives. Guest Stars Jeff Goldblum, Eddie Vedder.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Spyke and Irys want to have the most unconventional wedding ever. Toni & Candace have a book signing in store. Special guest star Jack McBrayer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Brendan & Michelle go to great lengths to ensure their son Grover gets accepted to the most prestigious pre-school in all of Portland.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor tasks Fred & Carrie with making Portland's police force a little easier on the eyes. Guest stars Kyle MacLachlan, Sean Hayes, Isaac Brock.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: In need of a gimmick, a Portland band takes on a new member while gaining a fanatical new groupie. Guest stars Kristen Wiig, Amber Tamblyn, Miranda July.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A visiting biker makes Peter and Nance feel old and unsexy, prompting them to resort to drastic measures. Guest star Joanna Newsom.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The 10th anniversary party for Toni and Candace's feminist bookstore is interrupted by a surprise guest. Guest stars Penny Marshall, LaMarcus Aldridge.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred & Carrie convince the Mayor to launch a campaign to ban the Olympics from Portland. Guest stars Greg Louganis, Kyle MacLachlan, Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portland's hottest brunch spot welcomes all the residents of Portlandia... but there's a wait. Guest stars Tim Robbins Kyle MacLachlan, Steve Jones.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: It's wintertime in Portlandia. Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets. Candace's son (Bobby Moynihan) visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: In this Season 3 premiere, Spyke & Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens. A group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor. Sandra has a crush on a man in her meditation class.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland. A pedicab driver hustles for clients. Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The daylong event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects. Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate, Alexandra. A movie theater sells artisanal concessions. The consultants from "Japanese Toys, Cool Offices" get to work.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kickstarter videos compete at the Can'ts Film Festival (hosted by Gus Van Sant). Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team. Guest starring Gus Van Sant, Paul Allen, The Portland Trail Blazers & dancers.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Brendan and Michelle decide that it's finally time to try drugs. Carrie's brother (Josh Homme) comes to visit with his new boyfriend. Women and Women First is visited by the cops. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Dan Savage, and Josh Homme.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Mr. Mayor (Kyle MacLachlan) unveils Portland's official 3D Printer. Santa is concerned about the future of Christmas. A minister (Ed Begley Jr.) reminds us that church is an option.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portlandia gets away for the weekend to New Beavertown, Oregon. Toni and Candace lead a feminist moon retreat for women (including k.d. lang).

programme.desc: The origin story of the feminist bookstore. A merger between two corporate book retailers pits young, sexy, shoulder-pad-wearing Toni and Candace against one another in fierce competition to be head of the Chick Lit Department.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A visit from Lance's mom and her new boyfriend puts pressure on Lance and Nina's relationship. Guest starring Justin Long.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A series of health ailments creates a desperate search for medical solutions. Guest starring Ed Begley Jr. and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Ecoterrorists travel to San Diego to take down their next target, Seaworld. Guest starring Jeff Goldblum and Natasha Lyonne.

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kath and Dave scramble to rehearse for a karaoke party. Guest starring Vanessa Bayer, Jeff Goldblum, and Paul Simon.

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. The Flaming Lips headline Portland's Pickathon Music Festival. Brendan and Michelle attend the festival via drone. Two concertgoers go boy-crazy. Guest starring Alia Shawkat, Kyle MacLachlan.

programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Fred wakes up with gray hair and sets out on a journey to find out how old he is. Carrie is faced with a life decision. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Natasha Lyonne, Mitchell Hurwitz and Kumail Nanjiani.

programme.desc: In the village of Malham Bridge, eccentric widow Isobel Hewitt and adulterous doctor Duncan Goff are both murdered while fly fishing near the riverbank. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of Martin Wroath is found in his home in Midsomer Worthy. From first appearances it looks as though he had committed suicide by shotgun. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Joyce joins the local watercolour society for an open-air art class, upon the village green in Midsomer Florey. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. The game is not only about competition but also raising funds for a great cause, benefiting Desire Street Ministries. programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 - University of Wisconsin vs. University of California San Diego
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center is electric as the Wisconsin Badgers face off against the UCSD Tritons on Championship Sunday. The match features a high-speed Racing intensity as both teams fight to stay alive in the single-elimination bracket. Fans will see the refined Skills of Kina Chang and the tactical precision of Lisa Ritchie as they trade "laser beam" drives and calculated dinks at the kitchen line. With Freestyle shot-making on full display—from around-the-post (ATP) winners to highlight-reel volleys—this quarterfinal clash proves that the best collegiate pickleball in the nation was truly saved for Sunday.

programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes intensity of a "Battle for the Bid" at the 2024 DUPR Florida Super Regional in Port Saint Lucie. This match pits the seasoned Kennesaw State Owls against a surprising Georgia Tech squad that is brand new to the tournament scene. Despite Kennesaw entering as the heavy 80% statistical favorite, the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets delivered a stunning wake-up call with a dominant 21–9 victory in Women's Doubles. Now, the Owls must lean on their powerhouse Men’s and Mixed Doubles teams to claw back and keep their championship dreams alive. With a direct invitation to the Collegiate Pickleball Nationals in Dallas on the line, every point is a fight for survival in this premier regional showcase.

programme.title: Ghost Stories 4: Following The Dead
programme.desc: Paranormal documentary Ghost Stories 4 marks filmmaker Dan T. Hall's final foray into seeking evidence of hauntings in Hoosier land. Peek into the spirit world through the camera lens as Hall and his team of investigators explore Hell's Gate, the site of a legendary train wreck that some say doomed its victims to forever wander the tracks; Black Moon Manor, a once majestic homestead in Mt. Comfort that also doubled as a funeral home as hundreds in the community fell to a small pox outbreak; and tread in the footsteps of infamous serial killer H. H. Holmes, who rented a cottage in historic Irvington for the express purpose of committing murder. The voices captured from beyond are truly bone-chilling!

programme.title: Unveiled
programme.desc: Embark on an enthralling journey with "Unveiled," a captivating TV series exploring the enigmatic world of aliens, UFOs, conspiracy theories, and extraterrestrial history. Each episode unveils astonishing encounters, hidden truths, and thought-provoking revelations that challenge reality itself. Discover a thrilling blend of scientific exploration, historical analysis, and captivating storytelling as "Unveiled" pushes the boundaries of human understanding and leaves audiences captivated by the mysteries of the universe.

programme.title: Ghostly Secrets of Hotel San Carlos

programme.title: Smile for the Dead: An Examination of Spirit Photography
programme.sub-title: Smile for the Dead: An Examination of Spirit Photography
programme.desc: 1869: William H Mumler stood trial for fraud in New York for claiming to photograph spirits of customers' deceased loved ones. Mumler walked free as experts of the day could not figure his methods. Was he a fraud? Or could he truly photograph the dead?

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: Hell's Tunnel & Prince Memorial
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society explore the remnants of a tunnel system once used by an asylum and prison, now known as “Hell’s Tunnel” due to its reported paranormal activity and then, the team embarks on a heartfelt investigation to reach out to the spirit of Prince in Henderson, Minnesota.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society dig into the urban legend of the "Lantern Man" in Le Sueur, Minnesota. Known locally as the "Brewery Hill Spook Light," the figure is rumored to walk the railroad tracks at night with a lantern. Adrian not only confirms the existence of the apparition but also reveals its identity and the reasons it haunts this area.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society venture underground to investigate the caves beneath Jordan Brewery in Jordan, Minnesota. In this unique paranormal investigation, the team encounters a mysterious "non-human" presence and captures stunning visual evidence deep within the caves.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: The Crazy Annie Story
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society dive into the urban legend of “Crazy Annie” in Henderson, Minnesota. The chilling tale tells of a grieving woman who drowned her children and hanged herself after her husband died in WWI. The team uncovers how much of this tragic story is rooted in fact and how much is pure fiction.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: The Litchfield Opera House
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate the historic Litchfield Opera House in Litchfield, Minnesota. While exploring the location, the team makes contact with two iconic Hollywood performers, Mary Angell and Gale Sondergaard, and captures a full-bodied apparition on thermal camera.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: A Night in Red Wing
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society conduct three investigations across Red Wing, Minnesota, including a stop at what Adrian calls “one of the most haunted locations he’s ever seen” in the basement of Liberty’s Restaurant. They also investigate the Sea Wing disaster memorial and the Red Wing train depot.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society explore the site of a 1933 shootout between the Barrow gang and police near Dexter, Iowa. Though Bonnie and Clyde escaped, the confrontation left Buck Barrow critically wounded and his wife Blanche in police custody. The team investigates lingering spirits from this infamous shootout.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate Green Lawn Cemetery in Southwest Minnesota, a site notorious for teenage “dares” and urban legends. What they uncover is much deeper than anticipated, revealing historical significance alongside paranormal activity.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society head to Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee for an epic season finale. The investigation spans four iconic locations, starting at the graves of Keith Whitley and Johnny Cash, and ending with an exploration of the Nashville Musicians Association union hall and the world-famous Sound Emporium Studios.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society continue their journey on Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee for an epic season finale. programme.title: Paranormal Destinations

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín trae a Rodrigo de regreso a casa. Magdalena está muy agradecida, aunque en el fondo ella ya no siente lo mismo por Agustín y ha comenzado a pensar en Gabriel. Él también piensa en ella a pesar de haberse reconciliado con Angie. A pesar de que Gabriel le cuenta a Nayarí que él es el padre de Deibis, ella se niega a que Gabriel entre en la vida del chico. Gabriel sólo buscar ayudar de cualquier manera, tratando de remendar su pasado irresponsable, según él. A fin de cuentas, Nayarí va a visitarlo para hablar con él. - Al enterarse que a Deibis le robaron la camioneta, Toño se enfurece, así que el chico decide ir a buscarla para recuperarla. Julieta encuentra una foto de Valentina junto a sus padres.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena está de acuerdo con Gabriel en que entre ellos dos algo pasa. Sin embargo como ambos tienen familias y vidas ya armadas, ella piensa que todo eso debe terminar. Mientras hablan, un paparazzi los ve y los fotografía. Luego, este le lleva las fotos a Ricardo un miembro de “La Deslenguada”. Estas podrían servir para comprobar una posible infidelidad por parte de los dos hacia sus respectivas parejas. Julieta continúa tratando de localizar a Gabriel para poder averiguar más sobre él y su vida. Es entonces cuando conoce a Valentina, la mujer que vio en la foto junto con sus padres, pero que no sabe la relación cercana que hay entre ellas. Los padres de Julieta no están de acuerdo con la vocación que eligió y por más de que tratan de que ella cambie de opinión no logran hacerlo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le entrega a Magdalena la información acerca del verdadero padre de su hijo, aunque ésta decide no abrir el sobre para no seguir arruinando su vida. Agustín minimiza los hechos, diciendo que el pasado forma parte del pasado. Gabriel envía a Epicúreo al barrio donde vive Nayarí, para que busque a Deibis y vea cómo él vive. Epi no lo distingue porque se encuentra junto a otros chicos y no lo puede distinguir. Luego de una persecución de Antonio, logra salir del barrio sin que le pase nada. Julieta conoce a Valentina en la oficina. Tanto Efraín como Ana Belén se preocupan por esto y llenan a su hija de preguntas, aunque en realidad no pasó lo que a ellos le da miedo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que cree que Heriberto abusó de ella. Esto enfurece a Alejandro que sale junto a ella para vengarse de Heriberto antes que se lo lleven en avión hacia Texas. Cuando llegan todo sale mal y Heriberto termina secuestrando a Sol y llevándosela en un auto. Heriberto la lleva al hospital y secuestra a la doctora que le hizo el examen a Sol para que le confiese la verdad. Así es como Sol se entera que Reina amenazó a su doctora para decirle que Heriberto abusó de ella.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana y Guillermo se conocen casualmente y se enamoran a primera vista, pero luego de una breve charla cada uno continúa su camino sin darse cuenta que no se han intercambiado teléfonos, excepto sus nombres. Este amor permanece en ellos durante tres años, se buscan mutuamente, pero sin ningún resultado positivo. La quiebra de los bancos europeos deja en bancarrota a los Ibáñez, quienes a partir de ahora deberán acostumbrarse a vivir en un ambiente menos lujoso. Y deben bajar su nivel de vida. Carlos Enrique se siente un inútil porque lleva más de 3 años sin trabajar. Tres años más tarde el destino vuelve a reunir a Guillermo y Ana, pero cada uno ya tiene su propia historia

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Las familias recién llegadas se van acomodando en sus nuevos hogares en el condómino. Ana y Guillermo se enteran que serán vecinos, noticia para la que ninguno estaba preparado. Ana descubre que su amor está casado y tiene una hija. Por la otra parte Guillermo descubre que la novia de su primo es su Ana que estuvo buscando por tres años. Ambos no pueden creer lo que les está pasando. El fantasma observa todas las casas del condominio a través de cámaras que él ha instalado en su Penthouse, tiene en vista a Conrado para su próxima estafa. Carlos Enrique, que ha estado casi mudo a causa de la depresión que le ha provocado la quiebra del banco donde tenía todos sus ahorros

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que se encontraran Ana y Guillermo, cada uno con una vida muy distinta a la que hubieran imaginado, pero sintiendo lo mismo que sintieron aquella primera vez que se vieron, quedaron con muchas preguntas por hacerse. Eso lleva a Guillermo a contactar a Ana mediante un mensaje, que luego se transformó en una visita hacia la casa de ella. Ya uno, enfrente del otro comenzaron a preguntarse sobre sus respectivas parejas. Pero llegan a un punto donde deciden arriesgarse del todo. El primer impulso es dejarlo todo y comenzar de nuevo, pero empiezan a surgir los inconvenientes, uno de ellos, Guillermo tiene una hija a la cual deberá sacrificar el verla sólo los fines de semana.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Stiv: No Compromise No Regrets (2023)
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. How did this native from Girard, Ohio end up living the life of Riley in Paris, France' Was Stiv really hit by a car (or a taxi...) on that fateful day' Who was the real Stiv Bators' These are a few of the questions answered in STIV.

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World (2025)
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Namibia : The Pearl Of Africa
programme.desc: “Namibia: The Pearl of Africa” is a documentary that explores the stunning natural beauty and diverse wildlife of Namibia, a country located in southern Africa. Viewers will be taken on a journey through the vast deserts, towering sand dunes, rugged mountains, and lush wetlands that make Namibia a unique and breathtaking destination.

programme.title: Top 10 İstanbul
programme.desc: Istanbul is a city that everyone admire; a city that has been an inspiration to poets, painters and authors for thousands of years. A city that has not been fully described, even though there are countless attraction points in Istanbul. Let us discover the 10 most popular sites including Topkapi Palace, Hagiasophia Mosque, Galata Tower, The Maiden's Tower and The Grand Bazaar.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore Erfurt, the capital city of the German state of Thuringia. During medieval times, a major trade route ran through Erfurt, shaping its history, culture and commerce. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she shops the Merchant’s Bridge, the city’s iconic covered bridge lined with the workshops of craftspeople, preserving time-honored traditions that connect to the past with a present-day appreciation of objects made with meaning, passion, and patience. Germany is the birthplace of the Bauhaus a revolutionary school of art, architecture, and design that thrived in the 1920s and 30s, becoming the trailblazer for present-day modernism. The influence of the Bauhaus is worldwide, including right here in Erfurt, reflected in the many handicrafts for sale.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Travel darling Krakow, Poland feels like a fairy tale with looming castles, medieval courtyards and even fire breathing dragons. But more modern history of the horrors of World War II and an occupation of communist rule did not leave Krakow unscathed. Today Krakow is a progressive and friendly city that invites travelers the world over to sample its layered history and many charms.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Prague, Czech Republic is simply awe-inspiring and firmly planted on the tourists’ trail. The Raw Travel crew digs deep to uncover underground charms by visiting with a variety of locals from diverse backgrounds as they showcase Prague’s culture and history like never before.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Romania’s capital city often gets short shrift as travelers passing through aren’t aware of its hidden, if sometimes gritty, charms. The Raw Travel crew, with the help of some savvy locals, shows them just what they’ve been missing.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: NYC Underground (Brooklyn & East Village)
programme.desc: The top of the heap for creative, eclectic arts is New York City. It’s time to take an alternative look at one of the most amazing cities in the world as Raw Travel stops in counter culture East Village, red-hot Williamsburg and iconic Coney Island, Brooklyn.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Transylvania is the fabled home of Dracula and the setting for all sorts of frightening, and mostly, fictional tales. Rob & crew uncover the real Transylvania on a road trip through striking landscapes dotted with old farmhouses and rural villages full of friendly folks, many who live as they did centuries ago.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Bratislava, Slovakia & Vienna, Austria
programme.desc: Separated by less than an hour or so by boat via the famous Danube you’ll find two major cities that, though proximate to each other, could not be more different. Not long ago, Bratislava and Vienna were at the edge, but opposite ends of the fabled Iron Curtain, which divided much more than just ideology. The crew explores the resulting and fascinating contrasts recent history has imposed, but mostly, shows travelers how they can have a good time appreciating the very different charms of each city.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: One of Eastern Europe’s crown jewels and much traveled destinations, Budapest gets the Raw Travel treatment. The crew enlists the help of savvy locals and expats to uncover some of the more hidden and decidedly less touristic charms of Budapest.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Bulgaria & the Black Sea
programme.desc: Rob and the Raw Travel crew road trip through Bulgaria to the Black Sea Coast where ancient history, contemporary adventure and some very good times await. But few adventures worth their salt come without tribulation. The crew’s resolve and resilience is tested as they overcome a major obstacle to continue their escapades through mystical and enchanted Bulgaria.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: New Orleans has much more to offer travelers than Mardi Gras and Bourbon Street. Rob returns for his first time post Hurricane Katrina to visit with long time locals and new transplants alike while discovering a surprising side of the Crescent City.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Louisiana Road Trip (Cajun Culture)
programme.desc: The Raw Travel team crosses over the Mississippi river to see how locals on the West Bank and well outside the tourist zones of New Orleans really live. Then Rob and crew embark upon a road trip to head deeper into rural Louisiana among the bayous and swamps to experience the unique language, delicious food, sights and sounds of French inspired Cajun culture.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel host, Robert Rose, was a young child during the U.S. and Vietnamese War, but the disturbing images never left his mind. Decades later, Rob visits Vietnam for the first time and discovers a culturally rich, diverse land that is on the move and welcoming travelers from all over the world, including the United States. Join the crew as they taste the unique gastronomy (snakes, frogs, etc.) and get a feel for centuries old traditions and culture.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Manila, the bustling capital city of the Philippines, is a perfect backdrop for Raw Travelers wishing to experience an alternative look at authentic Filipino culture. Rob and crew sample the delicious food and music while exploring the unique diversity of this exceptional Pacific Island nation. The crew meets a plethora of locals to get a real taste of the welcoming nature of Filipinos and learn why the Philippines is famous the world over for its unrivaled hospitality.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Laos is a small, landlocked and sparsely populated country in Southeast Asia and therein lies the charm. Surrounded by larger, more populous nations like Vietnam, Thailand & China, Laos is a haven without the swarming throngs of tourists. The relaxed, laid back but friendly nature of the Lao people is infectious and as more and more savvy travelers are finding, is helping Laos become one the loveliest hidden gems in all of Asia.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore journeys through the wonders of Lower Egypt, where history rises from the sands in majestic form. From the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx to the lesser-known but equally mesmerizing Saqqara and Memphis, Sandra brings ancient Egypt to life with vivid storytelling and immersive experiences. She explores the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, home to over 120,000 artifacts, golden treasures, and preserved mummies that tell the story of a civilization that continues to fascinate the world. In Memphis, Sandra stands beneath towering statues and uncovers the mystery of the alabaster sphinx. At Saqqara, she walks through Egypt’s oldest necropolis, rich with tombs that document everyday life in stunning detail. Along the way, Sandra offers expert travel tips to help viewers plan their own Egyptian adventure. This episode is more than a history lesson—it’s a journey into the heart of ancient wonder.

programme.desc: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Criminals, deadbeats and bad boys -- most women run from these types of men, but some women say Mr. Wrong is the right guy for them. Kelly says her daughter, Heather, married Mr. Wrong, and the price she paid was losing her children. Kelly says Heather's husband, Earl, is an unfit father and can't provide for the family. Heather, 25, says she stands by her 41-year-old husband, and wants her parents to stop sabotaging her marriage. Are Heather and Earl really unfit parents, or does Earl deserve a second chance? Then, Sarah, 29, says she's been married to three men in prison, and her current husband is serving a life sentence for murder. Even more shocking, she often takes her two young daughters to visit their stepdad behind bars, and she says they love to see him. Why is Sarah drawn to these types of men? Sarah's mom weighs in on her daughter's love life. And, a woman who gave up nearly 20 years of her life for a man in jail has an important message for Sarah. Will Sarah feel differently after meeting Darlene?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Face to Face with Jeffrey Dahmer
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Face to Face with Jeffrey Dahmer
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

Dr. Phil gives advice to this Brady Bunch gone wild!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.
